title: Multilingual Field Maintenance Audio Assistant
business: Remote industrial maintenance teams operating in regions with low literacy or high physical task intensity.
problem: Technicians struggle to document complex equipment repairs while wearing protective gloves, making text-based logging slow and prone to errors.
solution: Utilizing the gpt-4o-mini-audio-preview model to process raw voice reports directly via the Chat Completions API, allowing technicians to speak their findings and receive immediate, spoken troubleshooting guidance.
steps: Capture raw audio stream from the technician's headset device.
Send the audio data payload to the v1/chat/completions endpoint using the gpt-4o-mini-audio-preview model ID.
Configure the model to return audio output for direct playback to the technician.
Parse the returned audio response to confirm task completion or request clarification.
outcome: Improved documentation accuracy and reduced physical strain on technicians by eliminating the need for manual data entry during repair tasks.
limitation: The model is limited to the v1/chat/completions endpoint, meaning it does not support low-latency real-time session streaming; developers must monitor response latency to ensure the conversational flow remains acceptable for field use.

  messages=[{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Repair log audio data...'}],
  modalities=['audio'] # Requesting audio output modality
)
